1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping by way of single nucleotide polymorphism detection__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.
